item.title: National Taiwanese Presbyterian Council (NTPC)
item.description: National Taiwanese Presbyterian Council (NTPC) National Taiwanese Presbyterian Council (NTPC) is an organization of Taiwanese Presbyterian churches in the United States, operating under the Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.) [PC(USA)] system.

item.title: Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔)
item.description: Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔) Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔, Lai Ping-tung) was a Taiwanese Presbyterian pastor, Bible Society pioneer, and interdenominational evangelist whose three-stage ministry career spanned nearly 90 years.
